title: KSurvey: Lean formalization of the quartic L-value survey
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the elementary core of J. S. Farland, The coordinates of a quartic L-value: a formalized survey of the classical facts. Version 1.1 accompanies version 2 of the survey and adds the 2-power levels (file Levels.lean): vanishing of B_{1,psi} for even nontrivial psi and of the lower-level coset differences, integrality, pairing and parity of the coset coordinates at level 2^a, and the Murty-Thangadurai level invariant as a sum over odd exponents. The survey claims nothing new; every statement is attributed in the paper. No sorry, no native_decide; standard axioms only.
